answer: In an ocean of ballots, price is the tide sorting swimmers from farms. Each key buys ballots on Gitcoin's quadratic curve: one ballot costs $0.25, 100 cost $2,500, 10,000 cost $25 million. A fresh key must first serve 6 hours of relay work and plant a $25 bond in the grove, so a farm minting 10,000 ballots dies by the price check: spread thin, 60,000 hours of work and $250,000 in bonds burn; piled on one key, it pays $25,000,000 or every ballot is rejected. Every ballot wears its own pigment, so a cheap vote can never hide among dear ones: honest voters pay a quarter, farms pay an ocean.
